Graduate Applicants
Prospective graduate students apply to the Arnold School of Public Health using different
application methods depending on the graduate degree program. Before you apply, review
the application process and requirements carefully. Our Office of Graduate Student
Services is here to help you with any questions you have along the way.
Degrees Offered & Deadlines
The Arnold School offers 11 areas of graduate study, most of which contain multiple
degree programs. Learn more about important deadlines and degrees offered.
Application Requirements
The graduate application process will vary by the program and degree you are interested
in. Learn more about the unique application process and additional application requirements
for your degree program of interest.
Admissions Tests & Transcripts
As you prepare to take required tests such as the GRE or GMAT, it is important to be
mindful of deadlines and appropriate identification codes so that your scores are
received on time.
Tuition & Fees
Whether you are attending as a full- or part-time student, we want you to be prepared
for the cost of attending graduate school with us.
Financial Aid Information
There are a variety of ways to make your education affordable. Learn more about scholarships,
fellowships, internships and graduate assistantships that are available through both
the Arnold School and through the USC Office of Student and Financial Aid and Scholarships.
Frequently Asked Questions
A lot of thought and coordination goes into preparing for a successful graduate school
experience. From how to apply for assistantships to how long official test scores
are valid, we have answered many common questions.
Virtual Prospective Graduate Student Day
Join us for a virtual prospective graduate student information session to learn more
about Arnold School graduate programs.

11:30 am – 1:30 pm
